source_title: सारा अली खान के केदारनाथ दौरे पर विवाद: 'मंदिर पर्यटन स्थल नहीं...', संत जितेंद्रानंद सरस्वती ने उठाए सवाल
source_excerpt:
बॉलीवुड अभिनेत्री सारा अली खान इन दिनों अपने केदारनाथ दौरे को लेकर चर्चा में हैं। उनके मंदिर जाने और पूजा-पाठ करने पर विवाद खड़ा हो गया है। अब स्वामी जितेंद्रानंद सरस्वती ने सारा के मंदिर जाने पर कड़े सवाल खड़े किए हैं।

Haridwar, Uttarakhand: On actress Sara Ali Khan's visit to Kedarnath, Swami Jitendranand Saraswati, General Secretary of the Akhil Bharatiya Sant Samiti, says, "This is a matter for Muslim clerics, who should encourage their own women and daughters to participate. We have clearly said that if Islam believes Muslim boys should participate in our Dandiya Raas celebrations, then why only boys? Why shouldn't their entire families participate? Why shouldn't their daughters join as well? As for Sara Ali Khan, the Madras High Court ruled three days ago that Hindu temples are not tourist destinations but places of pilgrimage. People can visit if they have faith, but they must demonstrate that faith. We welcome this ruling."
#WATCH | Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh: All India Muslim Jamaat National President Maulana Shahabuddin Razvi Barelvi says, "I have received information, and many young Muslims have also asked me regarding actress Sara Ali Khan visiting the Kedarnath Temple and offering prayers. Is this permissible in light of Sharia, and does Sharia allow for such actions? Regarding this, I would like to clarify the perspective of Islamic Sharia and what its ruling is on this matter. For any Muslim, whether a man or a woman, to participate in the faith of another religion, offering prayers and performing religious rituals, is considered impermissible (najayaz) under Sharia. Such actions are not permitted... Therefore, if Sara Ali Khan performed these acts—visiting the Kedarnath Temple, offering prayers, and seeking blessings—of her own free will and volition, then she has committed a sin—an act that is haram..."
वर्कफ्रंट की बात करें तो सारा अली खान आखिरी बार आयुष्मान खुराना के साथ फिल्म 'उड़ता तीर' में नजर आईं।
इनके अलावा फिल्म में राहुल बोस, राम कपूर, सुहैल नैयर, गुलशन ग्रोवर, मुकुल देव, रघुबीर यादव, बृजेंद्र काला, संदीप आनंद, सुप्रिया पिलगांवकर और स्मिता तांबे भी अहम भूमिकाओं में नजर आए।
फिल्म 'उड़ता तीर' 23 अक्टूबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हो चुकी है।
